summaryEn: The document reports that the entity labeled "1.4(a)" observed one UAP at 1319Z during RTB. The UAP is described as triangular and metallic, located at 363453N 0255943E, at 24,989 ft MSL and 168 kts. The document is marked SECRET//NOFORN.
